papers.title: Microstructural and surface modifications and hydroxyapatite coating of Ti-6Al-4V triply periodic minimal surface lattices fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: State key Laboratory of Materials Processing and Die & Mould Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan 430074, Hubei, China. Electronic address: c_yan@hust.edu.cn

corresponding_authors.name: Chunze Yan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State key Laboratory of Materials Processing and Die & Mould Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan 430074, Hubei, China. Electronic address: c_yan@hust.edu.cn

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及激光熔化制备Ti-6Al-4V TPMS点阵用于生物医学植入物，但主要关注表面改性和涂层，未涉及应力屏蔽或力学性能匹配。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on surface modifications and hydroxyapatite coating of Ti-6Al-4V TPMS lattices, but does not include mechanical testing (compression/fatigue) or analysis of stress shielding and stiffness matching for load-bearing implants.

summary_zh.动机: 研究激光熔化制备的TPMS格子表面改性和羟基磷灰石涂层以改善生物活性。
summary_zh.方法: 通过SLM制备Ti-6Al-4V TPMS格子，进行酸蚀和碱处理，然后涂覆羟基磷灰石。
summary_zh.结果: 成功获得均匀的羟基磷灰石涂层，表面粗糙度和润湿性得到改善。
summary_zh.验证: 通过扫描电镜、X射线衍射和接触角测量表征表面形貌和成分。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate microstructural and surface modifications and hydroxyapatite coating on Ti-6Al-4V triply periodic minimal surface lattices fabricated by selective laser melting for improved bioactivity.
summary_en.method: Triply periodic minimal surface lattices were fabricated via selective laser melting, followed by acid etching and alkali treatment, and then coated with hydroxyapatite using a biomimetic process.
summary_en.result: Uniform hydroxyapatite coating was achieved on the lattice surfaces, with enhanced surface roughness and wettability.
summary_en.validation: Surface morphology and composition were characterized using scanning electron microscopy, X-ray diffraction, and contact angle measurements.

papers.title: Grain growth during selective laser melting of a Co–Cr–Mo alloy
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Auckland University of Technology, Auckland, New Zealand

corresponding_authors.name: Zhan Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Auckland University of Technology, Auckland, New Zealand

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文研究Co-Cr-Mo合金在选区激光熔化过程中的晶粒生长，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或力学性能测试。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses solely on grain growth mechanisms during SLM of Co-Cr-Mo alloy and does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, mechanical testing (fatigue or static), surface roughness, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解SLM Co-Cr-Mo合金的晶粒生长机制
summary_zh.method: 通过实验观察和理论分析研究工艺参数对晶粒形貌的影响
summary_zh.result: 发现温度梯度和冷却速率主导柱状晶向等轴晶转变

summary_en.motivation: To understand the grain growth behavior of Co-Cr-Mo alloy during selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Experimental characterization combined with theoretical analysis of thermal gradients and cooling rates.
summary_en.result: Columnar-to-equiaxed transition is governed by process parameters.

papers.title: Heat transfer and fluid flow of molten pool during selective laser melting of AlSi10Mg powder: Simulation and experiment
papers.first_author_affiliation: Chongqing Institute of Green and Intelligent Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Chongqing 400714, China

corresponding_authors.name: Linzhi Wang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Chongqing Key Laboratory of Additive Manufacturing Technology and Systems, Chongqing 400714, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究AlSi10Mg粉末选区激光熔化过程的热传递和熔池流体动力学，完全不涉及医用植入物、应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合等生物医学方向。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on the thermal-fluid behavior of AlSi10Mg during SLM, with no mention of porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness for osseointegration, or any biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解SLM过程中熔池热传递和流体流动机制。
summary_zh.method: 建立三维瞬态热-流耦合模型，并与实验熔池形貌对比验证。
summary_zh.result: 模拟预测的熔池尺寸与实验吻合，揭示了马里戈尼对流主导熔池演变。
summary_zh.validation: 通过光学显微观察的熔池截面与模拟结果对比。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the coupled heat transfer and fluid flow phenomena in the molten pool during selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A three-dimensional transient thermal-fluid model was developed and validated against experimentally measured melt pool geometries.
summary_en.result: The simulated melt pool dimensions and morphology agree well with experiments, revealing Marangoni convection as the dominant fluid mechanism.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by comparing simulated cross-sectional melt pool shapes with optical microscopy images of single-track experiments.
